declarations.name: HumanMachineSwapper
declarations.description: A Human / Machine pill. Machine shows the site's llms.txt, the plain-text reading written for language models, rendered in place over the page. Renders nothing at all when the site has no llms.txt to offer.

attributes.name: data-position
attributes.description: Which edge the pill is fixed to.

attributes.name: data-llms
attributes.description: The machine reading to link to. 'auto' reads <link rel="llms">, then probes /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt. When nothing answers, the component renders nothing and explains why in the console.

attributes.name: data-accent
attributes.description: Accent colour for the current dot and hover state.

cssProperties.name: --hms-top
cssProperties.description: Distance from the top edge. Set this AND --hms-bottom together when overriding: a fixed box with both set and height auto stretches. Use when the site's own chrome occupies the default edge.
cssProperties.default: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) when data-position is top-center, otherwise auto

cssProperties.name: --hms-bottom
cssProperties.description: Distance from the bottom edge. See --hms-top.
cssProperties.default: calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) when data-position is bottom-center, otherwise auto
